title_official: To amend title 10, United States Code, to require the Secretary of Homeland Security to maintain an annual limit on the amount of tuition assistance available for a member of the Coast Guard when the Coast Guard is not operating as a service in the Navy at an amount equal to the annual limit established by the Secretary of Defense with respect to tuition reimbursement for members of the Armed Forces, and for other purposes.
